instruction.name: vpickve2gr.du
instruction.description: Pick the 64-bit element at lane `idx` from `a`, zero-extend it to the GPR width, and store it in `dst`.

experiments.name: round trip through the reverse move
experiments.notes: vpickve2gr.du latency from a round trip through vreplgr2vr.d; the reverse move contributes 1 cycle(s).

latencies.notes: vpickve2gr.du latency from a round trip through vreplgr2vr.d; the reverse move contributes 1 cycle(s).

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vpickve2gr.du $r12, $vr8, 0; vpickve2gr.du $r13, $vr9, 0; vpickve2gr.du $r14, $vr10, 0; vpickve2gr.du $r15, $vr11, 0; vpickve2gr.du $r16, $vr12, 0; vpickve2gr.du $r17, $vr13, 0; vpickve2gr.du $r18, $vr14, 0; vpickve2gr.du $r19, $vr15, 0
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --counter 0xfb --init 'li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4' --asm 'vpickve2gr.du $r12, $vr8, 0; vpickve2gr.du $r13, $vr9, 0; vpickve2gr.du $r14, $vr10, 0; vpickve2gr.du $r15, $vr11, 0; vpickve2gr.du $r16, $vr12, 0; vpickve2gr.du $r17, $vr13, 0; vpickve2gr.du $r18, $vr14, 0; vpickve2gr.du $r19, $vr15, 0'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 7.99 cycles. Counter 0xfb normalised per instruction. The measured CPI 0.9988 is the nominal 1 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: vpickve2gr.du latency is 4 cycles, the same as the signed form, measured as a round trip through vreplgr2vr.d.
